import html from typing import List # Example template – adjust as needed for your application. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{heading}

Posted by: {poster}

{body}
{labels}
""" def create_forum_post(poster: str, heading: str, body: str, labels: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Args: poster: The author of the post. heading: The title of the post. body: The main content of the post (may contain line breaks and HTML‑like text). labels: A list of tags associated with the post. Returns: A string containing a well‑formed, HTML‑escaped representation of the post. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to avoid XSS and ensure well‑formedness. safe_poster = html.escape(poster, quote=True) safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) # Convert newlines in body to
tags for display while escaping content. safe_body_lines = [html.escape(line, quote=True) for line in body.splitlines()] safe_body = "
".join(safe_body_lines) # Render each label as a separate , escaping the text. safe_labels = " ".join( f'{html.escape(label, quote=True)}' for label in labels ) # Populate the template. rendered = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( poster=safe_poster, heading=safe_heading, body=safe_body, labels=safe_labels ) return rendered.strip()
